glosses: apex (moment of greatest success, expansion, etc.)

examples.text: Há neve no topo da montanha?
examples.en: Is there snow on top of the mountain?

examples.text: Consigo ver o topo da montanha.
examples.en: I can see the top of the mountain.

examples.text: No topo, havia um grupo de árvores.
examples.en: At the top, there was a clump of trees.

examples.text: Do topo podia-se ver o rio.
examples.en: From above, one could see the river.
